subject: Bloody marsh
topic: This wreck off South Carolina is likely an oil tanker sunk by a German submarine.
script:
This wreck off South Carolina is likely an oil tanker sunk by a German submarine.
Her name was SS Bloody Marsh.
In nineteen forty-three, she was on her very first voyage, from Houston to New York.
Her cargo: more than a hundred thousand barrels of oil.
On July second, a torpedo from the German submarine U sixty-six struck her.
It destroyed the engine room, and three crew members were killed.
The rest of the crew escaped on life rafts, before a second torpedo hit.
NOAA searched for her in twenty nineteen without luck. In twenty twenty-one, they found what's likely her remains.
Did you know U-boats came this close to the US?
